items.title: Tripadvisor Loan Soars as $600 Million Payment Boosts Confidence
items.summary: Tripadvisor Inc.’s loan soared Monday as the company repaid $600 million of debt using proceeds of a sale, easing concerns for lenders as it faces a major leadership change and challenges from generative artificial intelligence tools.
